preconditions.description: The integer k is between 2 and 12 inclusive.
The array a contains exactly 2^k integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < 2**k for x in a)
preconditions.description: Every element in the array a is an integer between 0 and 2^k - 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: if not exists_solution: stdout.strip() == 'Fou' else stdout.startswith('Shi')
postconditions.description: If no valid permutations exist, output 'Fou'; otherwise, the first line is 'Shi'.

postconditions.expression: if exists_solution: len(p) == 2**k and len(q) == 2**k and set(p) == set(range(2**k)) and set(q) == set(range(2**k))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, p and q are both permutations of integers from 0 to 2^k - 1.

postconditions.expression: if exists_solution: all(p[i] ^ q[i] == a[i] for i in range(2**k))
postconditions.description: For every index i, the XOR of p[i] and q[i] equals the corresponding element a[i].

postconditions.expression: if exists_solution: stdout.splitlines()[1].split() == [str(x) for x in p] and stdout.splitlines()[2].split() == [str(x) for x in q]
postconditions.description: The second and third lines of output contain the space-separated elements of p and q respectively.
